(1) different model parameters can produce similar neural dynamics, (2) neural dynamics can be directly related to model mechanisms, (3) neural dynamics can resolve behavioral model mimicry, but (4) simultaneous modeling of both behavior and neural dynamics is required to understand decision-making

1) the relationship between neural dynamics and decision- making mechanisms is complex, but in many cases, neural dynamics can be used to directly infer the underlying mechanisms, and 2) simultaneous modeling of neural and behavioral data is the most powerful approach for understanding decision-making and likely many other cognitive processes.
